title: Police or legal impersonation
summary: A caller uses legal consequences to demand money, documents, or device access.
scenario: The caller prevents you from checking the claim and presents payment as the only way to resolve it.
warning_signs: Demand for unusual payment or gift cards
safe_actions: End the call and do not follow its instructions
Seek advice from a trusted person or independently found service
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider if funds were sent
Preserve the call details and messages
reporting_guidance: Record the claimed identity and contact path
Use only independently verified reporting routes
prevention_tips: Caller ID and documents can be spoofed
A legitimate process should allow independent verification
false_positive_notes: A genuine legal matter can require prompt attention, but urgency does not remove the need to verify identity.
